nPlayer Plus is a universal video player for iOS. Since its launch in 2010 by the lead developer of Anki and AnkiWeb, AnkiMobile has remained a trusted tool for learners worldwide who require efficient, customizable, and effective study solutions on the go.

## Key Features
**Cloud Synchronization:** AnkiMobile offers a free cloud sync service that keeps your flashcard decks and study progress up to date across multiple devices. Add or edit cards on your desktop and continue studying effortlessly on your iPhone.**Advanced Scheduling Algorithms:** Utilize the proven SM2 and FSRS algorithms to review material at optimal intervals, ensuring you are reminded of information just before you are likely to forget it.**Customizable Interface:** Tailor your study experience with configurable actions for taps and swipes, and personalize tool button layouts for efficient navigation and control.**Comprehensive Statistics:** Access detailed graphs and reports that provide insights into your learning patterns, helping you track progress and stay motivated.**Support for Large Decks:** Manage extensive collections effortlessly, including decks containing over 100,000 cards without performance issues.**Offline Study Capabilities:** All images, audio, and media associated with your cards are stored locally on your device. ## Usage Notes
AnkiMobile is designed to work as a companion to the desktop Anki software, providing full compatibility for syncing and reviewing your flashcards. Purchasing AnkiMobile grants usage across multiple devices linked with the same Apple ID, and Family Sharing is supported except in some regions. Educational institutions are encouraged to explore Apple's Volume Purchase Program for bulk licensing options.

## What is PixelMe?
The App Store lists the app as AI Pixel Art Camera - PixelMe. It was made by Kazuya Saito, sits in Graphics and Design, and has been available since February 2021. The pitch is a two-stage workflow: first an AI model studies your picture and produces a pixel-art base automatically, then you take over and correct it by hand. The developer contrasts this with ordinary filters, which only shrink the resolution and leave you with a blocky copy of the original.
The editor is deliberately simple. You move a cursor over the canvas, tap to draw or erase, pick colours with a colour picker and zoom in to place single dots precisely. Resolution and level of detail can be adjusted to suit your own style. Typical uses named by the developer are profile pictures for Twitter, Instagram, Discord and TikTok, retro game assets, and general digital art made from selfies, portraits and landscapes.
Compared with a one-tap pixelate filter, the benefit is control. The AI gives you a starting grid within seconds, and every dot after that is yours to move, recolour or erase, which is why the store compares the result to dot art drawn by a pixel artist rather than a shrunken photo.
When the piece is done you export it in high quality, send it straight to a social network or keep it in the camera roll.

The App Store name is one sec | screen time + focus, from the developer riedel.wtf apps S.L., filed under Productivity and Health & Fitness. It first appeared in September 2020. The author's argument is that willpower alone loses against feeds designed to keep you scrolling, so the app adds friction to the apps you pick. ## What is Dropshare?
The App Store title is Dropshare - File Sharing Tool, from the developer Timo Josten, under Productivity and Utilities. Instead of keeping your files on its own servers, the app pushes them to storage you already use, then hands back a download URL to paste anywhere. That can be your own server, an S3-compatible bucket or a popular cloud drive.

Drive-style services include Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, pCloud and Nextcloud. Image hosts such as Imgur and Flickr are covered, and so are protocols like SFTP, FTP/FTPS, SCP and WebDAV, which need a working server account.
Uploading is built into the way iOS shares things: choose files from Photos or Files, or use the Share Extension in another app. One file, many files or a ZIP archive can go in a single upload. The upload history syncs across iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud, links can run through a custom domain or a shortener such as Bitly or the built-in dsh.re, and download pages can be styled to match your identity. **Nonograms Katana** is a premium puzzle game designed to sharpen your mind with addictive and challenging logic puzzles known as Nonograms. Also referred to as Hanjie, Griddlers, Picross, Japanese Crosswords, or Paint by Numbers, Nonograms require players to reveal hidden pictures by coloring or leaving blank cells within a grid based on numerical clues provided at the edges of the grid.
The numbers indicate how many continuous filled squares appear in each row or column, with at least one empty square separating different blocks. For example, a clue such as "4 8 3" signifies sets of four, eight, and three filled squares respectively, separated by at least one blank cell. Solving these puzzles involves careful logical deduction about which cells to fill (also called boxes) and which to leave empty (called spaces). Marking certain empty cells with symbols such as dots or crosses helps in the deduction process and prevents guessing, as every step must be supported by logic to avoid errors that could ruin the entire puzzle.

## About Analogue
The App Store name is Analogue - Film Camera, by the developer Cristian Teichner, in the Photo & Video category. The idea is to deliver cinematic colour, soft highlight roll-off and natural contrast at the moment of capture, without filters, tone mapping or heavy sharpening, so most shots need no editing afterwards. It is aimed at photographers who like a softer, filmic look.
There are two capture modes. Cine records in LOG for softer, less processed images, while Pro uses Bayer RAW for sharper, more detailed ones, and both carry the same look. RAW files can be saved as DNG, as processed images, or both, and DNGs can be reprocessed later in Analogue Studio, where you also adjust exposure, white balance, tint, crop and rotation. Video works in SDR, P3 and HLG, with presets and LUTs applied to all three.
Looks are handled through real-time presets that you can preview before shooting, save as custom styles and organise. You can import your own LUTs and tune them live, or begin with one of six built-in base looks, from the neutral one to a classic negative emulation. Other tools include Film Scan, film grain, Super Resolution at 12, 24 or 33 megapixels, a histogram with highlight clipping, Kelvin white balance, manual focus and exposure locking, with a 180-degree shutter angle bias for video.
---
## What the Analogue tweak unlocks
Subscription unlocked, which covers the paid features of the appPhoto and video capture in LOGLUT import and real-time adjustment, plus custom preset savingSuper Resolution stills up to 33MPManual and automatic exposure, with every lens on the phone reachableGallery with batch processing and the option to save graded plus original photos## Requirements and activation

**Zerocam** is a pure digital camera app that brings point-and-shoot photography back to your iPhone with simplicity and charm. It transforms your device into a small pocket camera designed for fun and effortless photo capturing.

Most stock camera apps use aggressive AI postprocessing to fix imperfections, often resulting in unnatural images with an unmistakable HDR appearance and flatness. Zerocam rejects this trend and delivers pure, natural photos without artificial enhancements.
---
## Zero Interface
Zerocam eliminates all distractions so you can focus on photography instead of fiddling with camera settings. Today’s mobile photo apps often overwhelm users with numerous features, exposure adjustments, focusing taps, and mode switches—making it easy to miss the decisive moment. We designed Zerocam to be the most accessible camera app ever.
The interface features a giant shutter button and no settings to adjust; all corrections and optimizations are preconfigured by us. There is **no focus control**, no exposure correction, no complex modes—just a simple click, and the app handles the rest. This experience is reminiscent of using a classic disposable camera, where you simply point, shoot, and enjoy the results.
---
## Authentic Photography Experience
Zerocam is designed for those who believe photography is about storytelling without distractions. There are no artificial postprocessing effects that ruin your photo with fake details or bloated interfaces that confuse the user. Instead, Zerocam delivers the essence of photography—capturing moments naturally and beautifully.
---
## How Zerocam Works
Captures temporary RAW data behind the scenes for accurate color processing.Automatically converts the RAW to a flat image, preserving natural tones.Applies a custom subtle lookup table (LUT) crafted to enhance the photo's look.Saves the final image as a compressed JPEG ready to share.
---
## Frequently Asked Questions
**Does Zerocam shoot RAW?** – No. Zerocam uses RAW internally for processing but exports final images as JPEGs.**Why no RAW shooting option?** – RAW is a professional format requiring further editing. Zerocam focuses on simplicity and immediate great results.**Where are the settings?** – There are none. Zerocam is designed for zero-configuration shooting.**How is focus handled?** – The focus is fixed on the middle of the frame, like a classic pocket camera.**Is there a selfie camera option?** – No dedicated selfie mode. Simply flip your device and shoot with the higher-quality primary camera.**Why so minimal?** – To make photography accessible and straightforward for everyone.**What happens when I press the shutter?** – Zerocam captures RAW data, processes it with the best available settings adjusted for light and scene, applies the custom color grading, and saves the image instantly.

apps.name: Web Video Cast
apps.localizedDescription:
**Web Video Caster®** is a powerful application designed to stream videos from your favorite websites directly to your TV. Whether it's movies, TV shows, live news, or sports, this app lets you effortlessly enjoy your preferred online content on a larger screen for an enhanced viewing experience.
The app supports a wide array of streaming devices, allowing you to connect and cast videos seamlessly. From popular streaming gadgets to smart TVs, Web Video Caster® ensures broad compatibility to accommodate your entertainment setup.

## Supported Streaming Devices
**Google Cast devices:** Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in**DLNA devices:** Includes Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs and more**Roku family:** Roku, Roku stick, and Roku TVs**Apple TV 4****Fire TV:** Fire TV and Fire TV stick**PlayStation 4** via its web browser**Most web browsers:** Access casting through supported browsers on various smart TVs, consoles, and set-top boxes## Supported Media Formats
**HLS live streams:** in M3U8 format (not supported by Chromecast and most DLNA devices)**Authenticated videos:** includes licensed movies and TV shows**MP4 videos****Live news and sports broadcasts****HTML5 videos** from websites
Please note that your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video format you are playing. Web Video Caster® itself does not perform any video or audio decoding or transcoding.
## How Web Video Caster® Works
This app functions as a specialized browser that locates and extracts the video URL embedded within a web page. Instead of playing the video on your mobile device, it sends the URL directly to your streaming device. The video then plays on your TV by streaming from the original content provider’s server. This approach conserves your mobile device’s battery life during playback. The app also detects available subtitles on web pages to enhance your viewing options.
Importantly, Web Video Caster® does not host any videos or media content – it strictly serves as a conduit for streaming content hosted elsewhere. This is not a screen mirroring app; instead, the streaming device plays the content natively.
---
## Get Started in Just a Few Steps
Browse online to find a video you want to watch.Ensure that the video can be played in mobile browsers without requiring Flash.Connect your mobile device to your streaming device or smart TV.Play the video through the app’s interface or select the play button in the toolbar to begin casting.
---
## Limitations and Important Notes
The app is not affiliated with any web media providers and does not control third-party content.Flash and FLV video formats are not supported.The app does not support tab casting such as the Chromecast browser extension for PCs.Playback issues related to the content provider’s server side, including buffering and failure to play, are beyond the app’s control and may occur during peak usage times.

apps.name: AR Code
apps.localizedDescription:
Scan a chair, a sneaker or a sculpture and look at it in three dimensions a minute later. Download the AR Code IPA for iPhone from builds.io and open **AR Code** with the premium plan unlocked.
## What is AR Code Object Capture?
The app is made by AR Code Pte. Ltd. and listed under Graphics and Design with Photo and Video as a second genre; its full App Store title is AR Code Object Capture 3D Scan. It has been available since November 2019. It is a capture tool for 3D models and, at the same time, a generator of AR QR codes, and it runs on iPhone, iPad and Macs with Apple silicon.
The scanning flow is guided. If your device has a LiDAR sensor, the app uses it to read geometry directly; without LiDAR, photos are processed by cloud photogrammetry to produce a detailed model. A newer option called AR Splat uses Gaussian Splatting for scans that look photorealistic, including transparent and reflective materials that ordinary photogrammetry struggles with.
Once a model exists, one tap creates an AR QR code. Anyone who scans it can view the object in their space without installing another app, which is handy for product demos, teaching and portfolios. The code can be restyled to match a brand, and an in-AR banner can be customised to engage viewers during the experience.
---

Subscription at the Premium level unlocked, opening all advanced featuresIn-app purchases enabled for free, according to the changelogGuided 3D scanning with LiDAR or cloud photogrammetryAR Splat capture for photorealistic resultsOne-tap AR QR codes with customisable design and banner## Price in the App Store and requirements
